tools.name: validate_cuit
tools.description: Validates an Argentine CUIT or CUIL number. Returns parsed components (prefix, body, check digit), person type, and whether the check digit is mathematically correct. Accepts any format: raw digits, hyphened (20-12345678-9), or spaced. This tool runs the REAL check-digit algorithm — not a demo fixtu

tools.name: get_fiscal_readiness
tools.description: Checks whether the business is ready to emit real ARCA electronic invoices. Returns { ready, missing, guidance } where ready=true means all fiscal fields and the ARCA certificate are configured.

tools.name: emit_invoice
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Emits an ARCA (formerly AFIP)-compliant electronic invoice (factura electrónica) for the authenticated business and returns the CAE authorization code.

tools.name: emit_nota
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Emits an ARCA-compliant Nota Crédito (NC) or Nota Débito (ND) against an original AFIP invoice and returns the CAE authorization code.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Creates a new product in the business catalog. Requires name and price.

tools.name: edit_product
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Updates a single product's fields (name, price, costPrice, or stockQuantity).

tools.name: stock_load
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Records inbound stock for a product — restock or initial stock, with an audit trail.

tools.name: adjust_stock
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Sets the absolute stock quantity for a product (inventory sync, no audit trail).

tools.name: delete_product
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Deletes (or soft-archives, when it has sale records) a product from the catalog.

tools.name: bulk_price_update
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Mass price change for all products or a specified subset in this business.

tools.name: query_catalog
tools.description: Lists active products in the business catalog. Returns products sorted by name, each with id, name, price (ARS), costPrice, sku, stock quantity, and weightGrams.

tools.name: open_catalog_selector
tools.description: Opens the catalog selector — a graphical product picker (MCP Apps widget) that shows active products with prices (ARS) and stock. Side-effect-free (no sale, no charge).

tools.name: register_sale
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Records a sale for the authenticated business. Creates a full Sale with SaleItems, decrements inventory, creates a CashMovement and Invoice.

tools.name: register_movement
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Records a cash-register movement for the authenticated business ('purchase', 'income', 'salary', 'tax', 'adjustment').

tools.name: return_sale
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Reverses the N most-recent sales within a time window. Restores inventory, removes CashMovement, SaleItem, Invoice, and Sale records. Destructive and irreversible.

tools.name: find_customer
tools.description: Searches customers in the business by name and/or phone. Returns up to 20 matching customers sorted by name.

tools.name: upsert_customer
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Creates a new customer or updates an existing one for the authenticated business.

tools.name: delete_customer
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Deletes a customer from this business (blocked when the customer has sales or invoices).

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Quotes shipment rates from every active courier configured for the authenticated business and returns options sorted by price ascending.

tools.name: create_shipment
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Creates a physical shipment via the chosen courier and returns a tracking number and label URL.

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Tracks the current status and event history of a shipment by tracking number.

tools.name: get_package_profile
tools.description: Computes the shipment weight and item breakdown for a package. Accepts a saleId, a list of productIds, or an explicit weightGramsOverride.

tools.name: send_whatsapp_text
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Sends a plain-text WhatsApp message to a customer phone number. Only valid inside the 24-hour customer-service window (Meta error 131026 outside).

tools.name: send_whatsapp_template
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Sends a pre-approved Meta WhatsApp template message. Window-independent — can be sent proactively, outside the 24-hour session window.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Returns the BYOA (Bring Your Own Account) integration readiness for the authenticated business — what is connected and how to connect what is missing. Read-only.

tools.name: caja_consultar_saldo
tools.description: Queries the current cash register balance for the authenticated business — the open session data or the last closed session. Read-only.

tools.name: caja_ciclo_caja
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Opens or closes a cash register shift for the authenticated business.

tools.name: caja_registrar_movimiento
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Records a cash movement tied to the OPEN caja shift: income, expense, withdrawal, tax, or payroll.

tools.name: get_payment_intent_status
tools.description: Checks the current status of a Velora PaymentIntent. Accepts a paymentIntentId OR a customer name.

tools.name: open_payment_link_wizard
tools.description: Opens the payment-link wizard — a graphical form pre-filled with the cobro, for the owner to review and confirm before any money moves. Side-effect-free (no charge).

tools.name: open_pending_orders
tools.description: Opens the pending cobros dashboard — a read-only widget listing PaymentIntents awaiting payment. Side-effect-free.

tools.name: open_cobro_status
tools.description: Opens the cobro status widget — a read-only view of ONE PaymentIntent's payment state. Accepts paymentIntentId OR customerName.

tools.name: open_delivery_receipt
tools.description: Opens the comprobante + envío widget — a read-only view of the delivery receipt for a completed cobro. Accepts paymentIntentId, saleId, OR customerName.

tools.name: create_tracked_payment_link
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Creates a tracked MercadoPago payment link for a catalog-tied cobro: atomically records the Sale + Invoice + PaymentIntent, then generates a real Checkout Pro link. MONEY: real and irreversible.

tools.name: list_suppliers
tools.description: Returns all suppliers for this business (up to 50, sorted by name).

tools.name: create_supplier
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Creates a supplier for this business.

tools.name: create_purchase_request
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Creates a procurement order (purchase request) to a supplier.

tools.name: edit_supplier
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Updates an existing supplier's fields.

tools.name: delete_supplier
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Deletes a supplier from this business (with full audit trail).

tools.name: query_sales
tools.description: Queries sales metrics from the database: 'ventas_periodo', 'margen', 'ranking_productos', 'por_empleado', or 'historial_cliente'.

tools.name: connect_mercadopago
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Connects MercadoPago for this business using the BYOA OAuth-redirect model. Primary: returns an authorization URL. Fallback: accepts a production access token directly.

tools.name: connect_pedidosya
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Connects PedidosYa for this business using the BYOA secure-form model. Primary: returns a secure link. Fallback: accepts an API token directly.

tools.name: connect_whatsapp
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Connects WhatsApp Business using the BYOA Meta Embedded Signup model. Primary: returns a signup link. Optional: registers a phone number as a lightweight pre-step.

tools.name: connect_tiendanube
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Connects Tienda Nube (Nuvemshop) using the BYOA OAuth-redirect model. Returns an authorization URL — no token ever passes through chat. Gated behind env config in production.

tools.name: upload_catalog
tools.description: [demo: deshabilitada] Bulk-creates products in the business catalog from a structured list (up to 50 items).

tools.name: open_sale_confirm
tools.description: Opens a VISUAL preview of a cash sale — resolved product names, unit prices, quantities, and total — with a confirm button that fires register_sale. Read-only preview itself.

tools.name: open_caja_status
tools.description: Opens a visual widget showing the current shift state and action buttons. Read-only here.

tools.name: open_onboarding
tools.description: Opens a graphical onboarding hub showing integration status and connect links. Read-only.

tools.name: open_business_overview
tools.description: ONE widget, two display modes: inline snapshot by default, fullscreen tabs (Cliente 360, Cerrar el día, Reposición de stock, Dashboard de ventas) on demand. Aggregates caja, payments, ventas, reportes, supplier, and customer reads.

tools.name: open_shipment_prep
tools.description: Combines catalog stock/weight data and a live shipping quote into one widget — resolves items, computes total weight, and quotes couriers. Read-only, side-effect-free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_payment_link_wizard · Private data: stock_load, delete_product, register_sale, register_movement, return_sale, caja_registrar_movimiento, create_tracked_payment_link, query_sales, connect_mercadopago, connect_pedidosya, connect_tiendanube · Public sink: send_whatsapp_text, send_whatsapp_template, upload_catalog · Destructive: validate_cuit, delete_product, delete_customer, delete_supplier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_payment_link_wizard · Private data: stock_load, delete_product, register_sale, register_movement, return_sale, caja_registrar_movimiento, create_tracked_payment_link, query_sales, connect_mercadopago, connect_pedidosya, connect_tiendanube · Public sink: send_whatsapp_text, send_whatsapp_template, upload_catalog · Destructive: validate_cuit, delete_product, delete_customer, delete_supplier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
